about: Reactors and reaction stations: set-temp (per zone / jacket / ramp), heat, temp, wait-temp, stir, flow, pressure, light, current, voltage, dose, program, safety-limit, method, start / stop / result with jobs, open / close with safety checks.

not_here.cem_libertyblue: peptide synthesizer: thin class (its contract has no reactor set points to map)
not_here.ika_plate_rctdigital: hot-plate reactions are covered by its thermal class (set-temp, heat, stir); no reactor verb would add anything

start.message: no sealed G30 vial is loaded in {inst}.
start.fix: ask the lab operator to load the sample vial.

start.message: the lid of {inst} is open.
start.fix: close and lock it: `chemlab run {inst} close lid`.

start.message: the lid of {inst} is closed but not locked.
start.fix: lock it: `chemlab run {inst} close lid`.

start.message: the cooling air of {inst} is not connected or not at 5.5-6 bar.
start.fix: ask the lab operator to connect it.

start.message: {inst} is running; it takes no new settings now.
start.fix: wait for it (`chemlab run {inst} wait`) or stop it (`chemlab run {inst} stop`).

method.message: {inst} is running; it takes no new settings now.
method.fix: wait for it (`chemlab run {inst} wait`) or stop it (`chemlab run {inst} stop`).

open:lid.message: {inst} is running; it takes no new settings now.
open:lid.fix: wait for it (`chemlab run {inst} wait`) or stop it (`chemlab run {inst} stop`).

open:lid.message: the vial in {inst} is still hot ({value}); the lid unlocks only at 50 °C or below.
open:lid.fix: let it cool; check `chemlab run {inst} status` until it shows 50 °C or below.

open:lid.message: the vial in {inst} is still under pressure ({value}); the lid unlocks only at 1.2 bar or below.
open:lid.fix: let it cool down and check `chemlab run {inst} status`.

method.configure:PRECONDITION_FAILED.message: {inst} refused the programme: its temperatures must lie inside the range the loaded sample's vapour-pressure model covers, and it cannot cool below 25 °C.
method.configure:PRECONDITION_FAILED.fix: choose temperatures inside that range (`chemlab call {inst} template.read --substance_id ID` lists it; ethanol, for example, up to about 90 °C) and cool to 25 °C or more.

method.configure:INVALID_ARGUMENT.message: {inst} refused the programme: cool-to is above the target, or ramp + hold is longer than 100 h.
method.configure:INVALID_ARGUMENT.fix: give cool <= temp and a shorter programme.

acquisition.start:PRECONDITION_FAILED.message: {inst} cannot start: it needs power, a sealed G30 vial, the lid closed and locked, cooling air, and a programme the sample allows (the vial must not already be above the target, its pressure under the limit).
acquisition.start:PRECONDITION_FAILED.fix: check `chemlab run {inst} status`; `chemlab run {inst} close lid` closes and locks the lid.

lock.set_travel:PRECONDITION_FAILED.message: the lid of {inst} stays locked while the vial is hot or under pressure (above 50 °C or 1.2 bar), or while a run is going.
lock.set_travel:PRECONDITION_FAILED.fix: wait until it has cooled (`chemlab run {inst} status`).

unsupported.set-temp: the reaction temperature is part of the heating programme (target, ramp, hold, cool), which this instrument takes only as a whole
unsupported.heat: microwave heating runs only inside a programme (`start`)
unsupported.wait-temp: the temperature follows the programme; follow the run with `start` and `wait` instead
unsupported.stir: the stirring speed is a programme setting
unsupported.pressure: no pressure set point: the vial pressure follows the temperature (its limit is the method key pressure)
unsupported.program: one programme per run: set it with `method`
unsupported.safety-limit: the safety limits are the programme's power and pressure limits (`method power=... pressure=...`)

alternatives.set-temp: `chemlab run INST method temp=80C ramp=2min hold=10min cool=50C`, then `chemlab run INST start`.
alternatives.stir: `chemlab run INST method stir=600rpm ramp=... hold=... cool=...`.
alternatives.heat: `chemlab run INST start` runs the programme set with `method`.
alternatives.wait-temp: `chemlab run INST start` gives a job; `chemlab wait job-N`.

method: ramp, hold and cool are not shown by the instrument, so give them every time; temp, stir, power and pressure are kept from the last programme when left out
the IR sensor reads only from 30 °C up; below that the temperature shows n/a
close: closing the lid also locks it (the run needs the lid locked)
open: the lid unlocks only when the vial is at 50 °C or below and 1.2 bar or below

acquisition.start:PRECONDITION_FAILED.message: {inst} cannot start: it needs power, the vial loaded with its cap lowered, electrodes connected, and enough substrate and electrode capacity for the charge.
acquisition.start:PRECONDITION_FAILED.fix: check `chemlab run {inst} status` and `chemlab run {inst} power on`.

unsupported.program: no temperature programme (the electrolysis settings are the method)
unsupported.safety-limit: no temperature limit (the compliance voltage is the method key voltage-limit)
unsupported.open: handled by the shared verbs (open cap)
unsupported.close: handled by the shared verbs (close cap)

current: sets constant-current mode and the current; the other electrolysis settings stay as they are (`status`)
voltage: sets constant-cell-voltage mode and the voltage; the other settings stay
stir: the speed is set in 10 rpm steps

light.message: the LED modules of {inst} are not fitted in this lab.
light.fix: ask the lab operator to fit them.

start.message: the lid of {inst} is open.
start.fix: close it: `chemlab run {inst} close lid`.

start.message: no vial is loaded in {inst}.
start.fix: ask the lab operator to load the vials.

start.message: the LED modules of {inst} are not fitted.
start.fix: ask the lab operator.

start.message: {inst} is running; it takes no new settings now.
start.fix: wait for it (`chemlab run {inst} wait`) or stop it (`chemlab run {inst} stop`).

method.message: {inst} is running; it takes no new settings now.
method.fix: wait for it (`chemlab run {inst} wait`) or stop it (`chemlab run {inst} stop`).

temperature.set:PRECONDITION_FAILED.message: {inst} has no heater or chiller: its fan only keeps the chamber under the set point, so the set point cannot be below the room temperature.
temperature.set:PRECONDITION_FAILED.fix: give a set point at or above room temperature (25 °C or more).

acquisition.start:PRECONDITION_FAILED.message: {inst} cannot start: it needs power, the lid closed, vials loaded and LEDs fitted.

unsupported.heat: no heater switch: the LEDs warm the chamber and the fan holds it under the set point
unsupported.safety-limit: the set point is the chamber maximum (fan cooling)
unsupported.open: handled by the shared verbs (open lid)
unsupported.close: handled by the shared verbs (close lid)

set-temp: the set point is a maximum: the fan cools the chamber towards room temperature; only the LEDs warm it
light: one intensity for all four LED modules (0-100 %)

heat.message: the vessel of {inst} is open; it heats only closed.

stir.message: the vessel of {inst} is open; the magnetic drive runs only with the head on.

open:lid.fix: switch it off first: `chemlab run {inst} heat off`.
stop it first: `chemlab run {inst} stir off`.

open:lid.message: the vessel of {inst} is at {value}; it may be opened only at 50 °C or below.
open:lid.fix: switch the heater off and let it cool: `chemlab run {inst} wait-temp --to 45C --max 2h`.

open:lid.message: the vessel of {inst} is at {value}, not at ambient pressure.
open:lid.fix: release it first: `chemlab run {inst} open vent` (then wait a few seconds).

thermal.set_temperature:PRECONDITION_FAI.message: {inst} refused the set point: it must be at least room temperature, and the pressure the closed vessel would reach there must stay under its 207 bar rating.
thermal.set_temperature:PRECONDITION_FAI.fix: choose a lower temperature, or vent first (`chemlab run {inst} open vent`).

lid.open:PRECONDITION_FAILED.message: {inst} may be opened only with the heater off, the stirrer stopped, at 50 °C or below and at ambient pressure.
lid.open:PRECONDITION_FAILED.fix: see `chemlab run {inst} status`; vent with `chemlab run {inst} open vent`.

unsupported.pressure: no pressure set point: the pressure follows the temperature and the gas in the closed vessel
unsupported.program: the 4848 controller holds one set point (no ramp / soak programme in this twin)
unsupported.safety-limit: the pressure rating is fixed by the vessel (rupture disc); the twin has no settable cut-off
unsupported.method: manual controller: no run programme; use set-temp, heat and stir
unsupported.start: manual controller: heating starts with `heat on`

alternatives.pressure: watch it with `chemlab run INST status`; release it with `chemlab run INST open vent`.
alternatives.start: `chemlab run INST set-temp 100C`, `chemlab run INST heat on`, `chemlab run INST stir 500rpm`.

stop: stop switches the heater off and stops the stirrer (the vessel stays closed and under pressure)
open: the lid opens only with the heater off, the stirrer stopped, at 50 °C or below and at ambient pressure (vent first)

the chip clamp of {inst} is open.
flow.fix: ask the lab operator to clamp the chip (`chemlab call {inst} clamp.set_lift --lift_m 0`).

start.message: the chip and reagents of {inst} are not set up in this lab.
start.fix: ask the lab operator.

start.message: the chip clamp of {inst} is open.
start.fix: clamp the chip first (`chemlab call {inst} clamp.set_lift --lift_m 0`).

start.message: {inst} is running; it takes no new settings now.
start.fix: wait for it (`chemlab run {inst} wait`) or stop it (`chemlab run {inst} stop`).

method.message: {inst} is running; it takes no new settings now.
method.fix: wait for it (`chemlab run {inst} wait`) or stop it (`chemlab run {inst} stop`).

pump.set_flow:PRECONDITION_FAILED.message: {inst} refused the flow: the pump channel must be initialised and idle (not in a method run), the flow inside the fitted syringe's range, the reagent bottle not empty, and the liquid must not boil at the chip temperature and back-pressure.
pump.set_flow:PRECONDITION_FAILED.fix: check `chemlab run {inst} status`; raise the back-pressure (`chemlab run {inst} pressure 5bar`) or lower the temperature.

acquisition.start:PRECONDITION_FAILED.message: {inst} cannot start: it needs power, the chip clamped, the system primed, a method, and pump pressure and boiling margins that allow it.
acquisition.start:PRECONDITION_FAILED.fix: check `chemlab run {inst} status`; raise the back-pressure if the solvent would boil.

method.configure:PRECONDITION_FAILED.message: {inst} refused the method: the pumps must be stopped and the flows and collection windows valid for the fitted syringes and collector.
method.configure:PRECONDITION_FAILED.fix: stop the pumps (`chemlab run {inst} flow off --channel N`) and check the values.

unsupported.stir: flow reactor: mixing happens in the chip
unsupported.safety-limit: no settable temperature limit in this twin
unsupported.open: no lid (the chip clamp is a set-up step: `chemlab call INST clamp.set_lift`)

flow: a flow on one pump starts manual pumping; flow off (or 0) stops that pump
pressure: the value is the back-pressure regulator setting (1-20 bar); pressure on|off switches the regulator
method: flows, inject and collect are lists: flows=0.5mL/min,0.5mL/min inject=0s,0s collect=[{"start_s":30,"end_s":120,"slot":0}]
the collector holds about 5 mL per run

flow.switch_fix: the pump runs only during a run: `chemlab run INST start` / `chemlab run INST stop`.

pressure.switch_fix: the pressure is held only during a run; give a value, e.g. `chemlab run INST pressure 30bar`.

set-temp.fix: wait for it (`chemlab run {inst} wait`) or stop it (`chemlab run {inst} stop`).

start.fix: ask the lab operator to close it.

start.fix: close it: `chemlab run {inst} close water_lid`.

start.message: {inst} is running; it takes no new settings now.
start.fix: wait for it (`chemlab run {inst} wait`) or stop it (`chemlab run {inst} stop`).

method.configure:INVALID_ARGUMENT.message: {inst} refused the method values (flow, hydrogen, temperature or pressure outside what the cartridge and pump allow).
method.configure:INVALID_ARGUMENT.fix: see `chemlab help {inst} method` for the ranges (liquid flow up to 3 mL/min).

method.configure:PRECONDITION_FAILED.message: {inst} refused the method: the pump must be stopped and the carrier's model must cover the temperature.
method.configure:PRECONDITION_FAILED.fix: stop the run first; choose a lower temperature.

acquisition.start:PRECONDITION_FAILED.message: {inst} cannot start: it needs power, the cartridge clamped, the water lid closed, the set-up confirmed, and a pressure drop and boiling margin that allow it.

unsupported.heat: the column heater follows the set point; there is no separate switch
unsupported.dose: the substrate is pumped, not dosed
unsupported.safety-limit: no settable temperature limit in this twin
unsupported.open: handled by the shared verbs (open water_lid)
unsupported.close: handled by the shared verbs (close water_lid)

set-temp: the H-Cube takes temperature, flow, pressure and time together; the others stay as they are
pressure: the value is the absolute system pressure (e.g. 30bar = 30 bar absolute)
temp: the cartridge clamp opens only at 50 °C or below: lower the set point after a hot run

set-temp.message: a programme is running in {target} of {inst}; it owns the set point.
set-temp.fix: stop it first: `chemlab run {inst} stop --zone N`.

heat.message: {inst} heats or cools a zone only with its cooling water confirmed (2-5 L/min, 5-35 °C).
heat.fix: ask the lab operator to connect the cooling source, then retry.

program.message: a programme is already running in {target} of {inst}.
program.fix: stop it first: `chemlab run {inst} stop --zone N`.

start.message: {inst} runs a programme only with its cooling water confirmed.
start.fix: ask the lab operator.

start.message: no programme is loaded in {target} of {inst}.
start.fix: load one: `chemlab run {inst} program 80C@30min,25C@0s --zone N`.

start.message: the programme in {target} of {inst} is already running.
start.fix: follow it with `chemlab run {inst} wait`.

thermal.set_temperature:PRECONDITION_FAI.message: {inst} refused the zone set point: below room temperature it needs the cooling water cold enough, all four zone targets must lie within 200 K of each other, and the machine must be on.
thermal.set_temperature:PRECONDITION_FAI.fix: check `chemlab run {inst} status`; choose a set point closer to the other zones.

thermal.set_enabled:PRECONDITION_FAILED.message: {inst} refused to switch the zone control on: it needs power, the cooling water confirmed and a set point the cooling allows.

thermal.start_program:PRECONDITION_FAILE.message: {inst} cannot start that programme: it needs power, the cooling water, a loaded programme and no programme running.

unsupported.safety-limit: the zone limits belong to the touch-pad experiments (pad.set_limits) and do not guard the direct set points
unsupported.method: no single method: the zone settings are separate (set-temp, stir) and the temperature profile is `program`

alternatives.method: `chemlab run INST program 80C@30min,25C@0s --zone 1`, then `chemlab run INST start --zone 1`.

start: start runs the zone's loaded programme (`program`) and gives a job
heat: heat on needs the cooling water confirmed by the lab (heating and cooling share the Peltier block)

set-temp.message: the emergency programme of {inst} is active; it takes no new settings.
set-temp.fix: remove the cause, then reset it (`chemlab call {inst} emergency.reset`).

set-temp:jacket.message: the emergency programme of {inst} is active; it takes no new settings.
set-temp:jacket.fix: remove the cause, then reset it (`chemlab call {inst} emergency.reset`).

stir.message: the emergency programme of {inst} is active; it takes no new settings.
stir.fix: remove the cause, then reset it (`chemlab call {inst} emergency.reset`).

safety-limit.message: the emergency programme of {inst} is active; it takes no new settings.
safety-limit.fix: remove the cause, then reset it (`chemlab call {inst} emergency.reset`).

dose.message: the emergency programme of {inst} is active; it takes no new settings.
dose.fix: remove the cause, then reset it (`chemlab call {inst} emergency.reset`).
wait for it (`chemlab run {inst} wait`) or stop it (`chemlab run {inst} dose stop`).

dose.message: the bottom valve of {inst} is open.
dose.fix: ask the lab operator to close it.

start.message: an experiment is already recording on {inst}.
start.fix: end it first: `chemlab run {inst} stop`.

dosing.start:PRECONDITION_FAILED.message: {inst} refused the dosing: the substance must be in its library and liquid at the feed temperature, the rate within the dosing unit, the filled volume at most 2 L, and the mixture must not boil near the current or safe temperature.
dosing.start:PRECONDITION_FAILED.fix: check the substance id and amounts; see `chemlab run {inst} status`.

thermostat.set_tr:PRECONDITION_FAILED.message: {inst} refused the Tr set point: it needs power, no emergency programme, at least 0.5 L in the reactor and an end value below the boiling point minus 2 K.
thermostat.set_tr:PRECONDITION_FAILED.fix: choose a lower temperature (`chemlab run {inst} status`).

safety.configure:PRECONDITION_FAILED.message: {inst} refused the limits: Tr min < Tsafe <= Tr max, the current readings inside the new limits, and Tsafe below the boiling point minus 2 K.
safety.configure:PRECONDITION_FAILED.fix: choose a limit above the current temperatures and Tsafe.

unsupported.heat: the thermostat controls whenever the instrument is on (Tr or Tj mode)
unsupported.pressure: no pressure control in this twin
unsupported.program: no stored programme: ramps are given per set point (`set-temp T --ramp 30min`)
unsupported.method: no method: the RC1 runs its steps live (set-temp --ramp, stir, dose) while an experiment records (`start`)
unsupported.open: no lid to open from chemlab

alternatives.heat: `chemlab run INST set-temp 50C` (Tr mode) or `chemlab run INST set-temp 40C --jacket` (Tj mode).

set-temp: without --jacket it sets the reaction temperature Tr (the jacket follows); --jacket sets the jacket Tj
--ramp reaches the end value over that time; --controller aqueous|organic|aqueous_pi|organic_pi (default aqueous)
start: start begins an experiment record (named with --name); the thermostat, stirrer and dosing keep running
stop: stop ends the experiment record; --cool-to T also cools the jacket to T
dose: dosing gives a job; `chemlab wait job-N` waits until the mass is dosed
